text:
Lina: Thinking out loud — can we standardize a compact deploy skeleton that covers pinning, canary, change-window, and an automated rollback tag? I keep retyping the same flags in runbooks.
Marco: +1. we've got too many local variants. Would love one canonical --dry-run + notes template.
Priya: I made a tiny experiment last week that folds preflight checks into the command. Works well for quick rollbacks.
Alex: If we do this, need good defaults: canary=10%, snapshot=true, fallback-model=small. Ops on call should be able to run `--fast-rollback` without thinking.
Jordan: Example sketch: 
```
/deploy 
  service=cart-api 
  version=sha:abc1234 
  window="2026-03-22T02:00Z..2026-03-22T03:00Z" 
  pin=true 
  canary=10 
  preflight=smoke,db-check 
  rollback-policy=auto:1h 
  notes="cherry-pick fix for checkout" 
  --dry-run 
```
Lina: Nice. Can we also support a compact tag like `@quick` that expands to a set of flags? e.g., `@quick` => `canary=5 preflight=smoke rollback-policy=manual`
Marco: release-bot could expand tag macros and print the expanded command for confirmation. release-bot:check could validate pin compatibility with pinned infra versions.
release-bot: Received: expand-tags(@quick) -> canary=5 preflight=smoke rollback-policy=manual. Will run a dry-run unless you confirm.
Priya: UX idea — have `--notes-template` that opens a small form to populate release notes fields and auto-inserts a changelog snippet. Saves time for product folks.
Alex: For on-call speed we should add `--escape` alias that triggers a simplified rollback flow: it marks the previous version as promote and triggers a controlled rollforward or rollback with a single confirm.
Jordan: Security question — pin=true should require a tag explaining why (e.g., legal/regulatory). Make release-bot reject pins without a `pin-justification` when account tier=enterprise.
Lina: Agreed. Also want a `--snapshot` flag to capture db schema migration state (checkpoint) and upload to S3 before migration step.
Marco: Canops — add a `--parallel` bool to let non-blocking deploys for low-risk services. Defaults to false.
release-bot: Suggestion: new subcommand `deploy template create` that outputs a one-line canonical deploy you can paste into runbooks. Example: 
`deploy template create --service cart-api --profile quick --window 2026-03-22T02:00Z/2026-03-22T03:00Z`
ops-bot: preflight checklist integration: when `preflight=` is set, ops-bot will post a checklist to the deploy channel and wait for two :thumbsup: before proceeding (unless `--auto-approve` is used).
Priya: Implementation note — keep the expansion rules in a small yaml under infra repo: `deploy-macros.yaml` so teams can add local macros without messing global bot rules.
Alex: Rollback retention: `rollback-policy=auto:1h` means auto-roll back if error rate crosses threshold within 1 hour. Need a standard metric set (latency, 5xx rate, error budget).
Lina: Ok next step — I'll prototype a small PR that adds `deploy template create` + `--profile` expansion and a `--pin-justification` required check for enterprise. Who wants to review?
Marco: I can take an initial pass on bot expand logic.
Priya: I'll write the preflight checklist integration tests.
Jordan: I'll audit pin justification flow for privacy/compliance edge cases.
Lina: Thanks — I'll open the PR and paste the prototype command and sample runbook snippet when ready. :rocket:
